title: Edgar Mitchell's Apollo 14 ESP experiment and Noetic society
summary: Clas Svahn tells of Edgar Mitchell's Apollo 14 ESP experiment and Noetic society, about 1971 at Apollo 14, space, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: it's an experiment with the Swedish guy

plain: A Swedish UFO researcher named Clas Svahn tells podcast host Jesse Michels about astronaut Edgar Mitchell on the Apollo 14 moon mission in 1971. Svahn says Mitchell ran an experiment in ESP, short for extrasensory perception, meaning reading minds or sensing things without the usual senses, together with a Swedish man. He links this to the society Mitchell later started to study the mind, and if it worked, it would mean thoughts can reach across space.
